svg.title: Rebuttal — A tweet's claim becomes six Nansen trace rows and one word: CONTRADICTED
svg.desc: A tweet's claim becomes six Nansen trace rows and one word: CONTRADICTED. Paste a claim; six Nansen calls land as trace rows; a deterministic rule fires; the verdict word turns red with the numbers that decided it.

g.text: Six Nansen calls decide whether it’s true — and show their work.
10 credits · 7 calls · 3.5 s · rules, not opinions · sha256 hash
built on the Nansen API · Meridian Buildathon · @edycutjong
